subject.title: feat(bedrock): enable prompt caching for Nova models

question: Which permanent seam should own Bedrock Nova cache-retention eligibility across the shared agent resolver and the Bedrock transport?
rationale: Repository policy keeps provider-specific model IDs out of core, but the shared extra-params path currently needs eligibility information before the plugin stream executes; choosing the durable provider capability contract requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Add a provider-owned normalization hook
options.body: Let the Bedrock plugin normalize or declare cache-retention eligibility through a generic provider seam consumed by the shared agent path.

options.title: Keep the core Nova allowlist
options.body: Accept the shared resolver's Bedrock-specific model table and require tests and ownership discipline to keep it synchronized with the plugin matcher.

options.title: Pause behind the canonical issue
options.body: Keep the feature tracked by the canonical issue until the provider capability contract and credentialed proof are available.

recommendation.title: Add a provider-owned normalization hook
recommendation.body: Let the Bedrock plugin normalize or declare cache-retention eligibility through a generic provider seam consumed by the shared agent path.

likelyOwner.reason: Their prior shared cache-retention work is the closest history signal for deciding the core-to-provider eligibility seam.
